task.task_desc: search for Alibaba Hangzhou, get driving directions, and begin the route

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for %_leftAlibaba Hangzhou%_right
Select the first search result
Choose the driving directions option
Start navigation

task.task_desc: search for HeyTea, find walking directions, and start the walk

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for %_leftHeyTea%_right
Select the first search result
Choose the walking directions option
Start navigation

task.task_desc: find nearby hotels, arrange them by distance, and navigate to the nearest one

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for %_lefthotel%_right
Arrange the search results by distance
Select the nearest hotel from the sorted list
Start Navigation to the hotel

task.task_desc: access saved locations and route to my apartment

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the "Saved" or "Favorites" section
Select My apartment from the list of saved locations
Start navigation to the location

task.task_desc: find nearby hotels that has lovers room and check availability

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for hotel
Apply the filter to show hotels with lovers room
Select the first hotel from the filtered results
Check availability for the selected hotel

task.task_desc: switch to night mode in the app

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the settings menu
Find the display or theme settings
Enable night mode

task.task_desc: post a new picture on my profile

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the profile settings
Tap on the area post pictures
Select the option to choose a photo from the gallery
Choose the first image from the gallery
Confirm to post the picture

task.task_desc: create a new group and invite ”suou“ to join

task_steps.task_step: Tap the button to create a new group chat
Tap the search bar and search for %_leftsuou%_right
Select the first search result corresponding to user suou
Tap the add button to include suou in the group
Confirm the creation of the group

task.task_desc: talk to user "suou" and answer his inquiries

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for %_leftsuou%_right
Select the first search result corresponding to user suou
Tap on the chat window to open the conversation with suou
Read the message from suou and type an appropriate response
Send the response by tapping the send button

task.task_desc: open profile settings, navigate to theme style, and choose a color theme

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the profile settings
Navigate to the dressing setting
Tap on the "Theme style" option
Select the first available color theme from the list

task.task_desc: post a message saying "Hello World"

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the main feed or posting interface
Tap the button to create a new post
Enter the text "Hello World" in the message input field
Tap the post button to publish the message

task.task_desc: post with a random picture and caption "This is it"

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the main feed or posting interface
Tap the button to create a new post
Tap the image selection icon and select the first image from the gallery
Enter the caption "This is it" in the caption input field
Tap the post button to publish the message

task.task_desc: search for the user Annie and follow her

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the search or discover section of the app
Tap the search bar and search for %_leftAnnie%_right
Tap on the first user profile named Annie of the users from the search results
Tap the follow button on Annie's profile to follow her

task.task_desc: search for a post about anime and like it

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the search or discover section of the app
Tap the search bar and search for %_leftanime%_right
Tap on the first post about anime of the posts from the search results
Give the post a like

task.task_desc: visit my profile and update my name to "Cool"

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the profile section of the app
Navigate to the interface of my information
Clear the existing name and enter "Cool"
Tap the save or confirm button to update the name

task.task_desc: search for a Bluetooth speaker and add it to my cart

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for %_leftBluetooth speaker%_right
Tap on the first Bluetooth speaker from the search result
Add this item to my cart

task.task_desc: find my coupons and check one of it

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to "My" interface
Navigate to "coupons" section
Select the first coupon from the list and check it

task.task_desc: clear all products from my shopping cart

task_steps.task_step: Tap the shopping cart icon in the bottom navigation bar
Select all items in the cart
Tap the delete or remove button to clear all selected items

task.task_desc: view all my pending payment orders

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to "My" interface
Navigate to "Orders" section
Select pending payment orders from the order status options

task.task_desc: enable facial recognition payment

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to "My" interface
Navigate to settings interface
Navigate to "facial recognition payment" setting
Enable "facial recognition payment"

task.task_desc: search for lemon video and give the thumbs-up

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the search or discover section of the app
Tap the search bar and search for %_leftlemon%_right
Select the first video from the search results
Tap the thumbs-up button below the video

task.task_desc: search for the user ayase yoasobi and subscribe it

Tap the search bar and search for %_leftayase yoasobi%_right
Select the first result of the users from the search list
Tap the subscribe button to follow the user

task.task_desc: pick a video from my favorites and give the video thumps up

Navigate to the "Favorites" section
Select the first video from the favorites list
Give the video thumps up

task.task_desc: pick a video from my favorites and adjust the playback speed to 0.5x

task_steps.task_step: Tap the "My" to access my personal page
Navigate to the "Favorites" section
Select the first video from the favorites list
Adjust the playback speed to 0.5x

task.task_desc: switch to night mode in the app

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the settings menu
Find the display or theme settings
Enable night mode

Tap on the artist's profile to enter it

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for %_leftlemon%_right
Play the first result of songs that matches "lemon"
Tap the "Like" or heart icon

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for %_leftBillie Jean%_right
Select the first result of songs that matches "Billie Jean"
Tap the "Like" or heart icon to add the song to Liked Songs playlist

task.task_desc: create a playlist titled Future Beats in my library

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to "My" interface
Locate and tap the option to create a new playlist
Enter the playlist name %_leftFuture Beats%_right
Confirm and save the playlist

task.task_desc: update my profile gender to male

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to personal information section
Locate the gender field and tap on it
Select "Male" from the gender options
Save the changes to update your profile

task.task_desc: search for nearby vegan-friendly restaurants, filter by budget, and sort them by proximity

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for %_leftvegan-friendly restaurants%_right
Select the filter option and apply budget range

task.task_desc: search for nearby cafes, filter by distance, and navigate to the nearest one

task_steps.task_step: Tap the search bar and search for %_leftcafes%_right
Select the filter option and apply distance range

Start navigation

task.task_desc: find the first store in my recent orders and navigate to the merchant

Tap the "My Orders" or "Recent Orders" section
Select the first order from the list of recent orders
Tap on the merchant information associated with the first order
Tap the navigation button to navigate to the merchant location

task.task_desc: check my recently viewed merchants list in the app

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to "My" interface
Navigate to the "Recently Viewed" section
Select the "merchants" option

Select the first search result that matches HeyTea
Tap on the "Write Review" or "Leave a Review" button
Select the 5-star rating option
Submit the review

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the interface of World Clock

Tap the search bar and search for %_leftBeijing%_right

Set the time to 9:00 am
Enable the repeat option and select Monday and Thursday

Tap the "add" button to add a new alarm

Save the alarm

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the settings section
Find and tap on time setting option

task.task_desc: set my sleep sound to "Firefly"

task_steps.task_step: Navigate to the settings section
Tap on the option to change the sleep sound
Select "Firefly" from the list of available sleep sounds
